summary.text: Jimmy Matlock is the Republican candidate for Tennessee State Senate District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat David Miller.
A business owner, he served in the Tennessee House of Representatives from 2007 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Matlock attended Middle Tennessee State University from 1978 to 1979 and the University of Tennessee from 1980 to 1982.
During his time in the state House he was the owner of Matlock Tire Service, which he had owned since 1982.
Matlock represented District 21 in the Tennessee House of Representatives, assuming office in 2007 and leaving in 2018.
He served on committees including Transportation, which he chaired in the 2015 legislative session, and Insurance and Banking.
He did not seek re-election to the House in 2018 and instead lost the Republican primary for Tennessee's 2nd Congressional District on August 2, 2018.
Matlock advanced from the Republican primary for State Senate District 5 on August 6, 2026.
